purpose: After V1 showed a label-projection failure not repaired by answer capitalization, select one balanced no-system Mistral demonstration on calibration and qualify it once on untouched holdout.
selection_rule: Calibration-qualified candidates only; maximize inline easy accuracy, then minimum easy label recall, then descriptive primary accuracy, then earlier candidate order.
holdout_rule: Score only the selected calibration renderer once. The same frozen gate must pass; no fallback renderer or retry is authorized.
claim_boundary: A passing gate qualifies one fixed Mistral-native prompt projection only for the frozen synthetic one-hop easy control. Demonstrations define the no/yes map but do not solve target facts. Multi-hop rows remain descriptive. It does not establish workspace semantics, cache amplification, training benefit, broad generalization, or free-chat behavior.
